title: Flying in MallWorld?
content: Are you able to successfully fly inside your Mall? For example I am always flying over escalators instead of using them, usually I'm flying to escape and find the exits I need. Usually this happens when I begin to become lucid, once that happens I begin to get chased out of my mall world by mall guards, into the parking lot where I have to tirelessly and quickly find my car after the mall goose chase. If I can't find a car, usually I give up and fly out of there and wake up right after. Lol. This one's a common one for me.
